cross_card_test: per X twin with data on this arm and in E218 (aifoundry3 card 0): e_here = |ln(measured / MM1-v3.2's frozen forecast)| on this card at its registered clock, e_a3 = the same on aifoundry3 card 0 (frozen here from E218's committed measurement and MM1-v3.2's frozen E218 forecast); d = e_here - e_a3, decided when |d| exceeds the arm's tie (cycles for CX-T, joules for CX-E); the exact two-sided sign test over the decided: 'LARGER HERE' (MM1-v3.2's error larger on this card) or 'SMALLER HERE' at p < 0.05 with at least 10 decided, else NOT DECIDED; TOO FEW under 10; NO DATA with none. CX-T: the wall cycles an op; CX-E: W over idle given the measured op time (A + B / t_op) at twins measured at 3 W or more on both cards. Per arm (CX-T, CX-E) and pooled (CXP-T, CXP-E). REPORTED beside: the per-twin ln(measured here / measured on aifoundry3) of the wall cycles (MM1-v3.2's time has no per-card term: the clock alone)
head_to_head_test: per case (time) or point (energy) d = |ln(measured / second)| - |ln(measured / first)| (at a watts point |W - second| - |W - first| in W); FIRST closer when d > the tie, SECOND when d < -tie; the exact two-sided sign test over the decided: '<first> BETTER' / '<second> BETTER' at p < 0.05 with at least 10 decided, else NOT DECIDED; TOO FEW under 10; NO DATA with none.
